title: Qwen3.5-Omni Technical Report
paper_type_zh: 前沿全模态模型技术报告与数据披露台账
best_for_zh: 审计全模态语料声明与缺失后训练证据之间差距的读者。
one_line: Qwen3.5-Omni reports aggregate text-vision and 100M-plus-hour audio-visual training scale plus ARIA, but its official abstract leaves post-training data, feedback, and audit artifacts undisclosed.
Qwen3.5-Omni 报告文本—视觉和超过一亿小时音视频语料、256K 上下文与全模态能力，但未披露后训练数据、奖励/verifier、rollout 或审计细节。
why: The entry records the meaningful aggregate disclosure without treating it as a reproducible dataset, reward system, or reasoning-training recipe.
inclusion_reason: A current official omni-modal report with a rare aggregate disclosure of audio-visual scale, retained as a ledger record precisely because the source, post-training, and audit detail remains unavailable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Qwen3.5-Omni aligns text, image, audio, video, speech generation, tool use, and long-context interaction while trying to avoid cross-modal degradation. This is not one homogeneous data problem: encoder alignment, broad multimodal pretraining, long-context extension, specialist distillation, audio-to-text behavior transfer, interaction trajectories, multilingual speech preferences, and speaker adaptation use different record types and feedback contracts.

The report exposes stage structure and several aggregate token/hour counts, but it does not publish the underlying corpora or stage manifests. More than 100 million hours of audio-visual content, 40 million hours used for the audio encoder, and more than 20 million hours used for Talker training are author-reported aggregates whose overlap and source membership are not fully specified. Benchmark coverage and API availability do not establish provenance, consent, licensing, decontamination, or item-level quality.

Qwen3.5-Omni 需要对齐文本、图像、音频、视频、语音生成、工具使用和长上下文交互，同时避免跨模态退化。这并非单一同质的数据问题：编码器对齐、广泛多模态预训练、长上下文扩展、领域蒸馏、音频到文本行为迁移、交互轨迹、多语言语音偏好与说话人适配，分别使用不同记录对象和反馈契约。

报告披露了阶段结构及若干聚合 token/小时数，却没有发布底层语料或分阶段清单。超过 1 亿小时音视频内容、音频编码器使用的 4000 万小时，以及 Talker 使用的 2000 多万小时，都是作者报告的聚合量；它们是否重叠、各自包含哪些来源，没有得到完整说明。benchmark 覆盖面与 API 可用性不能证明来源、同意、许可、去污染或样本级质量。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Pretraining has three disclosed stages. Encoder alignment freezes the language model while adapting vision and audio encoders. A general 32,768-token stage trains all parameters on an approximately 4T-token mixture spanning text, audio, image, video, and video-audio records. A 262,144-token stage increases long audio/video exposure. Separately, AuT is trained from scratch on 40M hours of audio-text pairs generated by Qwen3-ASR, with a reported Chinese:English:multilingual ratio of 3.5:3.5:3.

Thinker post-training uses ChatML-formatted text, vision, audio, and mixed-modality conversations. Specialist teachers trained independently with SFT and RL generate domain data; on-policy distillation pairs an audio query with its text form and transfers the stronger text-conditioned response; interaction-aligned RL uses multi-turn trajectories and rewards language consistency, persona stability, and sustained instruction following.

Talker has a separate four-stage path: more than 20M hours of multilingual speech with multimodal context, quality-stratified 64K continual pretraining augmented by a captioner, DPO on human multilingual preference pairs plus GSPO with rule rewards, and lightweight speaker fine-tuning. These descriptions support mixed feedback and multiple supervision granularities, but exact record counts, reward formulas, and released artifacts remain unknown.

预训练包含三个已披露阶段。编码器对齐阶段冻结语言模型并适配视觉、音频编码器；32,768-token general stage 在约 4T-token 的文本、音频、图像、视频与视频—音频混合上训练全部参数；262,144-token 阶段提高长音频/视频占比。另有 AuT 从零开始使用 Qwen3-ASR 生成的 4000 万小时音频—文本对训练，报告的中文:英文:多语言比例为 3.5:3.5:3。

Thinker 后训练使用 ChatML 格式的文本、视觉、音频及混合模态对话。由 SFT 与 RL 独立训练的领域教师生成各领域数据；on-policy distillation 将音频查询与其文本形式配对，并迁移更强的文本条件回答；interaction-aligned RL 使用多轮轨迹，奖励语言一致性、角色稳定性与持续指令遵循。

Talker 另有四阶段路径：超过 2000 万小时带多模态上下文的多语言语音、由 captioner 增强的质量分层 64K 持续预训练、人工多语言偏好对上的 DPO 加规则奖励 GSPO，以及轻量说话人微调。这些描述足以支持“混合反馈”和多种监督粒度，但精确记录数量、奖励公式和开放产物仍为 unknown。

title: Method
方法
html:
The pretraining mixture includes pure text, image-text, video-text, audio-text, video-audio, and video-audio-text records. Audio is resampled to 16 kHz and encoded by AuT; explicit timestamp strings are inserted for temporal patches, with random timestamp intervals for audio, to improve cross-modal time alignment. The report lists modality-token totals for the general stage, but they sum beyond the stated approximate 4T total, so the numbers should remain author-reported rather than silently reconciled.

For Thinker specialist distillation, reasoning, coding, agent, vision, and audio teachers are all initialized from the Qwen3.5 base checkpoint and trained independently. Their generated outputs are distilled into one model. OPD uses paired audio/text queries, with the text-conditioned answer as the audio target. Interaction RL constructs multi-turn trajectories for code-switching, persona, and long-conversation instruction-following objectives; reward weights, judge identities, rollout settings, and trajectory counts are not disclosed.

Talker starts from more than 20M hours of multilingual speech paired with multimodal context. A curation pipeline stratifies quality before 64K continual pretraining with captioner augmentation. Human multilingual comparisons create DPO pairs, while rule rewards feed GSPO; speaker tuning follows. Exact pair counts, filtering thresholds, formulas, annotator protocol, sampling settings, language balance by stage, consent, speaker rights, and licenses are unknown.

预训练混合包含纯文本、图文、视频—文本、音频—文本、视频—音频和视频—音频—文本记录。音频重采样为 16 kHz 后由 AuT 编码；时间 patch 前加入显式时间戳字符串，音频还随机插入时间戳，以改善跨模态时间对齐。报告列出的 general stage 各模态 token 数相加超过“约 4T”的总量，因此应保留为作者报告值，而不能自行调和。

Thinker 的推理、代码、智能体、视觉和音频教师均从 Qwen3.5 base checkpoint 初始化并独立训练，再将生成输出蒸馏进统一模型。OPD 使用成对音频/文本查询，以文本条件回答作为音频目标。交互 RL 针对语言切换、角色一致性和长对话指令遵循构建多轮轨迹；奖励权重、裁判身份、rollout 设置和轨迹数量未披露。

Talker 从 2000 多万小时带多模态上下文的多语言语音开始。专用策展流水线先做质量分层，再以 captioner 增强数据进行 64K 持续预训练；人工多语言比较形成 DPO 偏好对，规则奖励进入 GSPO，最后做说话人微调。精确数量、过滤阈值、公式、标注协议、采样设置、阶段语言比例、同意程序、说话人权利和许可证均为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official arXiv v2 report supports the three pretraining stages, aggregate token/hour counts, specialist-teacher construction, paired-query OPD, interaction objectives, human preference training, rule-reward GSPO, and Talker stages. It also states that the model is available through an API. No official downloadable training set, preference set, teacher-output collection, interaction-trajectory set, reward log, source inventory, or stage manifest is linked in the checked Card artifacts.

The report contains extensive evaluation across text, vision, audio, audio-visual, speech, long-context, reasoning, and agent tasks. Those results are evidence about model behavior under the stated evaluation protocols. They do not validate individual training records, reveal source rights, establish consent for voice material, or show that the post-training feedback stack is reproducible. API access verifies service availability, not training-pipeline availability.

官方 arXiv v2 报告支持三段预训练、聚合 token/小时数、领域教师构造、paired-query OPD、交互目标、人工偏好训练、规则奖励 GSPO 与 Talker 各阶段。报告还说明模型可通过 API 使用。已核查的卡片产物没有链接到官方下载训练集、偏好集、教师输出集合、交互轨迹集、奖励日志、来源清单或阶段 manifest。

报告包含文本、视觉、音频、音视频、语音、长上下文、推理与智能体任务上的大量评测。它们是特定评测协议下模型行为的证据，不会验证每条训练记录，也不揭示来源权利、语音材料同意程序，或证明后训练反馈栈可复现。API 可用性只能证明服务存在，不能证明训练流水线可获得。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
A distinctive disclosed data operation is modality-conditioned distillation: an audio query and its text counterpart share semantics, and the stronger text-conditioned response becomes the supervision target for audio. This makes the cross-modal transfer object more concrete than a generic claim that audio and text are mixed.

Interaction-aligned RL likewise converts code-switching, persona drift, and long-conversation instruction decay into trajectory-level feedback goals. Talker separately stages acoustic scaling, quality stratification, captioner augmentation, human preference pairs, rule feedback, and speaker adaptation. The stage separation is useful for an audit even though the records and feedback implementations are closed.

ARIA and long-context architecture affect how text and speech tokens are aligned and served, but they should not be mistaken for a disclosed reasoning-data selection rule. The report's useful contribution to the disclosure ledger is the stage map and record-type hints, not its benchmark position.

较有辨识度的数据操作是模态条件蒸馏：音频查询与对应文本查询共享语义，较强的文本条件回答成为音频监督目标。这比笼统地声称“混合音频和文本”更具体地定义了跨模态迁移对象。

interaction-aligned RL 则把语言切换、角色漂移和长对话指令衰减转化为轨迹级反馈目标。Talker 另行分阶段处理声学规模扩展、质量分层、captioner 增强、人工偏好对、规则反馈和说话人适配。即使记录与反馈实现未公开，这种阶段划分仍有审计价值。

ARIA 与长上下文架构影响文本/语音 token 如何对齐和服务，但不能被误写为已披露的推理数据选择规则。对披露账本而言，真正有用的是阶段图和记录类型线索，而不是其 benchmark 排名。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Source inventories, licenses, consent and speaker-rights procedures, deduplication, decontamination, train/test separation, stage yields, teacher revisions, preference volumes, interaction-trajectory counts, judge reliability, reward weights, and sampling settings are undisclosed. Reported modality token counts may overlap and sum beyond the stated approximate 4T total, so they should remain author-reported rather than treated as an exact partition.

Qwen3-ASR-generated audio-text pairs and captioner-augmented long-context data can propagate transcription, language, timing, and hallucination errors. No error-rate audit or retention threshold is given. Human preferences and interaction rewards may encode language, accent, persona, cultural, or annotator bias; annotator recruitment, instructions, agreement, and adjudication are unknown.

The relation among the headline 100M-plus audio-visual hours, AuT's 40M hours, Talker's 20M-plus hours, and the tokenized pretraining mixture is not fully specified. Without item-level lineage and stage manifests, these aggregates cannot be reconciled into a reproducible corpus. Voice-cloning and speaker adaptation also create privacy, consent, impersonation, and downstream-use risks that aggregate performance tables do not address.

来源清单、许可证、同意与说话人权利程序、去重、去污染、训练/测试隔离、阶段产率、教师版本、偏好规模、交互轨迹数量、judge 可靠性、奖励权重和采样设置均未披露。报告的各模态 token 数可能重叠，且相加超过“约 4T”的总量，因此应保留为作者报告值，不能视为精确分区。

由 Qwen3-ASR 生成的音频—文本对和 captioner 增强的长上下文数据，会传播转写、语言、时间对齐与幻觉错误；报告没有给出误差审计或保留阈值。人工偏好与交互奖励可能编码语言、口音、角色、文化或标注者偏差；标注者招募、说明、协议一致性与仲裁均为 unknown。

标题中的 1 亿多小时音视频、AuT 的 4000 万小时、Talker 的 2000 多万小时和 token 化预训练混合之间的关系没有完整说明。缺少样本级谱系与阶段清单时，这些聚合量无法还原为可复现语料。语音克隆和说话人适配还带来隐私、同意、冒用和下游使用风险，聚合性能表不能回答这些问题。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
The report is useful as an omnimodal data-architecture map. It separates encoder alignment, broad pretraining, long-context extension, specialist teachers, paired-modality distillation, interaction trajectories, speech-quality curation, preference pairs, rule rewards, and speaker adaptation. That separation helps curators avoid collapsing all training into one aggregate “100M hours” claim.

For reasoning-data analysis, Thinker OPD and interaction-aligned RL are the most concrete post-training objects: paired audio/text queries define a distillation target, while multi-turn trajectories define interaction-level feedback. Talker DPO and GSPO add preference and rule-bearing records, but the disclosed rules are not sufficient to reproduce an RLVR pipeline.

This Card should be used as a frontier disclosure ledger, not as a reusable corpus. Reuse would require source and rights inventories, stage manifests, record schemas, teacher/checkpoint versions, prompt templates, rollout and decoding settings, reward implementations, preference annotations, and contamination audits.

该报告可作为全模态数据架构图，区分编码器对齐、广泛预训练、长上下文扩展、领域教师、成对模态蒸馏、交互轨迹、语音质量策展、偏好对、规则奖励与说话人适配。这种拆分能避免把所有训练笼统归为“1 亿小时”。

对推理数据分析，Thinker 的 OPD 与 interaction-aligned RL 是最具体的后训练对象：成对音频/文本查询定义蒸馏目标，多轮轨迹定义交互级反馈。Talker 的 DPO 与 GSPO 又加入偏好和规则型记录，但已披露规则仍不足以复现 RLVR 流水线。

本卡片应作为前沿披露账本使用，而不是可复用语料。真正复用还需要来源与权利清单、阶段 manifest、记录 schema、教师/checkpoint 版本、prompt 模板、rollout 与解码设置、奖励实现、偏好标注和污染审计。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3 and 4 as separate ledgers: pretraining has encoder-alignment, 32K general, and 262K long-context stages; post-training then splits into three Thinker stages and four Talker stages.
  • Keep the headline 100M-plus audio-visual hours, AuT's 40M hours, Talker's 20M-plus hours, and the approximately 4T-token mixture separate; the report does not provide a non-overlapping item manifest.
  • OPD transfers a text-conditioned response to its paired audio query. Record the pairing and target direction; do not describe it only as generic distillation.
  • Interaction-aligned RL uses multi-turn objectives, while Talker uses human-preference DPO plus rule-reward GSPO. Exact reward and rollout contracts remain unknown.
  • Do not equate 256K/262K context, ten hours of audio, or 400 seconds of video with a reasoning-rollout budget.
  • Treat all benchmark tables as model evaluation, not corpus-quality, provenance, consent, or licensing evidence.

• 将第 3、4 节作为两个账本阅读：预训练含编码器对齐、32K general 和 262K 长上下文阶段；后训练再拆成三个 Thinker 阶段与四个 Talker 阶段。
  • 分开记录 1 亿多小时音视频、AuT 的 4000 万小时、Talker 的 2000 多万小时和约 4T-token 混合；报告没有提供互不重叠的样本清单。
  • OPD 将文本条件回答迁移到其成对音频查询。应记录配对关系与目标方向，不能只写成笼统蒸馏。
  • interaction-aligned RL 使用多轮目标，Talker 则使用人工偏好 DPO 与规则奖励 GSPO；精确奖励和 rollout 契约仍为 unknown。
  • 不要把 256K/262K 上下文、十小时音频或 400 秒视频等同于推理 rollout 预算。
  • 所有 benchmark 表都只是模型评测，不是语料质量、来源、同意或许可证据。
